module.name: Provisioner
module.changelog: *1.0.5* Profile resources: a profile serves the other files a phone asks it for -- <mac>-phone.cfg, <mac>-directory.xml and the rest -- each a filename and a template of its own, edited on a Resources tab of the profile *1.0.4* Unauthenticated device endpoint at modules/oryk_provisioner/provision.php: a phone fetches its config with ?mac=<mac>, no admin login, by bootstrapping FreePBX directly instead of going through config.php *1.0.3* Rendered configuration at ?display=oryk_provisioner&mac=<mac>&config=, with {{ }} placeholders filled in from the device, its extension and the profile *1.0.2* Devices and Profiles: a MAC address is associated with a FreePBX device and a profile, and a profile is a name and a block of configuration text *1.0.1* New
module.description: Provision and manage VoIP endpoints with standardized device configurations for softphones, Yealink, Polycom, Grandstream, and other supported devices. Generate configuration data in JSON, XML, key-value, and device-specific formats.
